en.图片超过宿主允许的大小，请压缩后重试。: The image exceeds the Host size limit. Compress it and try again.
en.图片限制无效：请输入正整数，原图接收上限和总量上限不能小于单图上限。: Invalid image limits: enter positive integers. The receipt and total limits must be at least the per-image limit.
en.在 163 邮箱「设置 → POP3/SMTP/IMAP」中开启服务，并新增授权: In 163 Mail open Settings → POP3/SMTP/IMAP, enable the service, and add an authorization password.
en.在 QQ 邮箱「设置 → 账户」中开启 IMAP/SMTP 服务，并生成 16: In QQ Mail open Settings → Account, enable IMAP/SMTP, and generate a 16-character authorization code (not your login password).
en.在“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 完全磁盘访问权限”中，打开运行 DeepSe: In System Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access, enable the terminal or app running DeepSeek Harness.
en.在“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 自动化”中，允许运行 DeepSeek Ha: In System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation, allow the app running DeepSeek Harness to control Messages.
en.在企业微信中创建自建应用，即可在微信里使用: Create a self-built app in WeCom to use it inside WeChat
en.在应用管理后台创建自建应用，开启「接收消息」并填入下面的参数。成员的微信关注该企: Create the self-built app in the WeCom admin console, enable receive-messages, and fill in the parameters below. Once members follow the enterprise WeChat plugin, they can chat with this app directly inside WeChat.
en.在微信中确认连接该机器人: Confirm the bot connection in WeChat
en.在授权页点击“一键创建新机器人”: Select “Create new bot” on the authorization page
en.在腾讯授权页面确认创建或绑定机器人: Confirm bot creation or connection on the Tencent authorization page
en.在腾讯授权页面确认创建智能机器人: Confirm bot creation on the Tencent authorization page
en.填写 Discord Developer Portal 的 Bot Token: Enter the Bot Token from the Discord Developer Portal
en.填写 Lark 开放平台 App ID: Enter the Lark Developer App ID
en.填写 Lark 开放平台 App Secret: Enter the Lark Developer App Secret
en.填写 QQ 开放平台 AppID: Enter the QQ Open Platform AppID
en.填写 QQ 开放平台 AppSecret: Enter the QQ Open Platform AppSecret
en.填写 homeserver 地址与访问令牌，或者用户 ID 与密码，即可让机器人: Enter the homeserver URL with an access token, or a user id with a password, and the bot receives messages over the CS API long poll and replies with rich text.
en.填写 homeserver 地址，并提供访问令牌，或者用户 ID 与密码的组合。: Enter the homeserver URL plus an access token, or a user id with a password. The bot only talks to that homeserver and never to third-party servers.
en.填写企业微信智能机器人 Bot ID: Enter the WeCom AI Bot ID
en.填写企业微信智能机器人 Secret: Enter the WeCom AI Bot Secret
en.填写使用者的 Open ID（ou_xxx），不是机器人 ID: Enter the user’s Open ID (ou_xxx), not the bot ID
en.填写可发消息的 Channel ID: Enter a Channel ID the bot can message
en.填写飞书开放平台 App ID: Enter the Feishu Open Platform App ID
en.填写飞书开放平台 App Secret: Enter the Feishu Open Platform App Secret
en.增强提示词中请使用字段名（如 senderId、conversationType: Reference these values by field name (such as senderId or conversationType) in the guidance. Only selected fields available in the current message are sent; no extra lookups are made.
Reference these values by field name (such as senderId or conversationType) in the guidance. Only fields selected and available in the current conversation are sent; no extra lookups are made.
en.增量添加当前缺少的卡片回调 card.action.trigger、读取消息内图: Adds the missing card callback card.action.trigger, im:message:readonly for reading images or files in messages (shown by Feishu as “Read direct and group messages”), im:resource for uploading images or files sent by the bot, and application:app_slash_command:read / write for the native command panel. The confirmation page shows only missing items; no new app is created.
en.复制失败，请选中命令后按 Ctrl+C 或 ⌘C 复制。: Copy failed. Select the command and press Ctrl+C or ⌘C to copy it.
en.复制配置后，在 Slack 选择 From a manifest；创建完成后生成: Copy the manifest and choose “From a manifest” in Slack. Then create a connections:write App Token and install the app to your workspace.
en.字段位置中的序号从 0 开始，按文件中的条目顺序计数，不包含真实账号标识。: Field positions use zero-based entry order in the file without including actual account identifiers.
en.字段缺失或不是非空字符串。: The field is missing or is not a non-empty string.
en.安装失败，请检查当前安装状态后重试。: Installation failed. Check the current installation before retrying.
en.安装结果校验失败，请手动检查插件版本。: Installation verification failed. Check the plugin version manually.
en.安装超时，请先确认当前安装状态，再决定是否重试。: Installation timed out. Check the current installation before retrying.
en.实时显示思考步骤与工具调用，最终答案单独成条: Show thinking steps and tool calls as they happen; the final answer arrives as its own message
en.实时过程卡（全程一张卡片动态更新）: Live process card (one card updated throughout)
en.宿主拒绝了本次图片输入。原图已保存到工作区，请根据文件清单使用可用工具读取或分析: The Host rejected the image input. Originals are saved in the workspace; use the file list and available tools to read or analyze them. Do not assume you have seen the images.
en.尚无可覆盖的发件人（先在上方配置允许的发件人）。: No senders to override yet (configure allowed senders above first).
en.尚未确认“获取群组中所有消息”权限，请完成飞书授权。: The “Read all messages in associated group chat” scope has not been confirmed. Complete Feishu authorization.
en.尚未确认目标版本，此命令安装执行时 npm 的 latest 版本。: No target version has been confirmed. This command installs the npm latest version available when you run it.
en.工作区修改失败，请重试。: Could not update the workspace. Try again.
en.工作区必须是绝对路径。: The workspace must be an absolute path.
en.工作区路径不存在。: The workspace path does not exist.
en.工作区路径必须指向一个目录。: The workspace path must point to a directory.
en.工作区路径必须是当前操作系统的绝对路径。: The workspace path must be absolute on the current operating system.
en.已从会话自动填入目标信息；确认后再保存。: Target details were filled from the conversation. Review them before saving.
en.已保存的思考强度已不可用，请选择其他强度或恢复默认。: The saved reasoning effort is unavailable. Choose another effort or restore the default.
en.已取得扫码地址，但本机二维码图片生成失败。: The login URL was obtained, but the QR-code image could not be generated locally.
en.已取消补全权限与回调。: Completing permissions and the callback was cancelled.
en.已安全保存；留空保持不变: Stored securely; leave blank to keep it
en.已开通“获取群组中所有消息”权限（im:message.group_msg）；机: The “Read all messages in associated group chat” scope (im:message.group_msg) is granted; the bot processes every visible group message.
en.已由接入流程确认的所有者可以访问并执行命令，不受本页限制。未识别到所有者身份时，: Owners confirmed during connection setup can access the bot and run commands regardless of these settings. When no owner has been identified, these access settings apply.
en.已确认，正在完成权限与回调配置: Confirmed. Completing permissions and callback setup
en.应用详情页的 Secret: The Secret from the app details page
en.开启后逐步推送工具调用与过程说明: Push tool calls and process notes step by step
en.开启后，在群聊或私聊里 @机器人 提问，机器人会在那条消息下新建一个飞书话题并在: When enabled, mentioning the bot in a group or a private chat opens a dedicated Feishu topic under that message and the answer stays inside it. That topic is an independent conversation in dsh, and later messages in the topic belong to the same conversation. A bare "@bot" (which opens the menu) opens no topic, and messages without a mention stay in the chat's own conversation.
en.开放模式命令权限覆盖用户不能包含重复的用户标识。: Open-mode command permission overrides cannot contain duplicate user IDs.
en.开放模式命令权限覆盖用户必须是数组。: Open-mode command permission overrides must be an array.
en.开放模式默认命令权限必须是布尔值。: The open-mode default command permission must be a boolean.
en.当前 Agent Preset 已不可用，请选择其他 Preset 或跟随 Ho: The current Agent Preset is unavailable. Choose another preset or follow the Host default.
en.当前 Host 不支持更新接口，请先手动更新插件并重启。: This Host does not support the update API. Update the plugin manually and restart first.
en.当前 Host 的 Node.js 版本不满足新版要求，请先更新运行环境。: The Host Node.js version does not meet the new version’s requirements. Update the runtime first.
en.当前 npm 源配置与官方源不一致，请先检查 registry 配置。: The npm registry configuration differs from the official registry. Check your registry settings first.
en.当前地址与浏览器的本机请求校验不兼容。请使用上方按钮改用 localhost 重: This address is incompatible with the browser’s local-request checks. Use the button above to reopen with localhost.
en.当前插件安装不完整或与 profile 不符，请手动检查安装配置。: The plugin installation is incomplete or does not match this profile. Check the installation configuration manually.
en.当前是源码或链接安装，只能检查版本；请手动更新源码，或迁移到 npm 安装。: This is a source or linked installation. You can check versions, but must update the source manually or migrate to an npm installation.
en.当前模型不支持图片，请用 /models 查看可用模型，再用 /model <序: The current model does not support images. Use /models to list models, then /model <number> to switch and resend.
en.当前模型不支持所选思考强度，请重新选择。: This model does not support the selected reasoning effort. Choose another effort.
en.当前模型已不可用，请选择其他模型或跟随默认模型。: The current model is unavailable. Choose another model or follow the default.
en.当前没有白名单用户，保存后普通用户将无法使用机器人。: There are currently no allowlisted users. After saving, regular users will not be able to use the bot.
en.当前没有选择任何指令，保存后「/」面板会变成空的。: No commands are selected; saving leaves the "/" panel empty.
en.当前浏览器不支持自动复制，请手动选择复制。: Automatic copy is unavailable. Select and copy the value manually.
en.当前消息的发送时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss（本机时区）。: When the current message was sent, as YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss in the local time zone. The platform send time is used when available; otherwise the send time is decoded from the WeChat message ID. If neither is available, <dsh_im_source> omits sentAt even when the field is selected. WeChat is the only channel that provides it today. Naming your time zone in the guidance makes ordering judgements more accurate.
en.当前渠道不支持群聊: Group chat is not supported by this channel
en.当前渠道暂不支持投递目标。: Delivery targets are not supported for this channel.
en.当前渠道暂不支持访问设置。: Access settings are not supported by this channel yet.
en.当前运行环境不支持按钮安装，请手动更新插件。: This runtime cannot install through this button. Update the plugin manually.
en.当前配置版本不允许此字段。: This field is not allowed in this configuration version.
en.微信二维码已生成，请使用手机微信扫描。: WeChat QR code generated. Scan it with WeChat on your phone.
en.微信初始化失败，请查看 DSH 启动日志。: WeChat initialization failed. Check the DSH startup logs.
en.微信已授权，但 Harness 健康检查发生未知错误。请查看 dsh web 日: WeChat was authorized, but the Harness health check failed unexpectedly. Check the dsh web logs.
en.微信已授权，但 Harness 健康检查超时。请确认 dsh web 未阻塞。: WeChat was authorized, but the Harness health check timed out. Confirm that dsh web is not blocked.
en.微信已授权，但 Harness 健康检查返回服务错误。请查看 dsh web 日: WeChat was authorized, but the Harness health check returned a service error. Check the dsh web logs.
en.微信已授权，但 Harness 拒绝了健康检查请求。请查看 dsh web 日志: WeChat was authorized, but Harness rejected the health-check request. Check the dsh web logs.
en.微信已授权，但 Harness 拒绝了本机健康检查。请检查 Host 信任配置。: WeChat was authorized, but Harness denied the local health check. Check the Host trust configuration.
en.微信已授权，但 Harness 返回了无法识别的响应。请确认 Harness 与: WeChat was authorized, but Harness returned an unrecognized response. Confirm that Harness and the plugin are compatible.
en.微信已授权，但找不到 Harness 健康检查接口。请确认 Harness 与插: WeChat was authorized, but the Harness health endpoint was not found. Confirm that Harness and the plugin are compatible.
en.微信已授权，但插件无法连接本机 Harness。请检查 dsh web 地址和端: WeChat was authorized, but the plugin could not connect to the local Harness. Check the dsh web address and port.
en.微信已授权，但无法初始化账号状态或工作区。请检查 DSH_HOME 和工作区目录: WeChat was authorized, but the account state or workspace could not be initialized. Check DSH_HOME and the workspace directory.
en.微信已授权，但无法读取现有登录凭据。请检查 DSH 凭据存储。: WeChat was authorized, but the existing login credential could not be read. Check the DSH credential store.
en.微信已授权，但消息连接初始化失败。请查看 dsh web 日志后重试。: WeChat was authorized, but the message connection could not be initialized. Check the dsh web logs and try again.
en.微信已授权，但激活过程中发生未知错误。请查看 dsh web 日志。: WeChat was authorized, but an unknown error occurred during activation. Check the dsh web logs.
en.微信已授权，但登录凭据无法写入 DSH 凭据存储。请检查凭据存储是否可写。: WeChat was authorized, but the login credential could not be written to the DSH credential store. Check that the store is writable.
en.微信已授权，但账号配置无法写入本机。请检查 DSH_HOME 目录权限。: WeChat was authorized, but the account configuration could not be saved locally. Check the DSH_HOME directory permissions.
en.微信已确认，正在启动消息连接: Confirmed in WeChat. Starting the message connection
en.微信已绑定，可以开始向已绑定的机器人发消息。: WeChat is connected and ready for messages.
en.微信扫码服务没有返回有效的绑定任务: WeChat did not return a valid setup attempt
en.微信授权成功，但返回的账号凭据不完整。: WeChat authorized the account but returned incomplete credentials.
en.微信操作发生未知错误。: The WeChat operation failed with an unknown error.
en.微信操作失败后，原账号状态恢复失败。: The previous account state could not be restored after the failed WeChat operation.
en.微信服务地址不是有效 URL。: The WeChat service address is not a valid URL.
en.微信服务地址必须使用受信任的 HTTPS 域名和端口。: The WeChat service address must use a trusted HTTPS domain and port.
en.微信服务域名解析失败，请检查运行 DSH 的机器的网络和 DNS 设置后重试。: The WeChat service domain could not be resolved. Check the network and DNS settings on the machine running DSH and retry.
en.微信服务拒绝了二维码申请。: The WeChat service rejected the QR-code request.
en.微信服务未确认停止通知。: WeChat did not confirm the stop notification.
en.微信服务没有返回有效二维码。: The WeChat service did not return a valid QR code.
en.微信服务没有返回有效的账号列表: WeChat did not return a valid account list
en.微信服务请求超时。: The WeChat service request timed out.
en.微信服务返回了不受信任的扫码地址。: The WeChat service returned an untrusted QR-code URL.
en.微信服务返回了不受信任的连接地址。: The WeChat service returned an untrusted connection URL.
en.微信服务返回了无效的连接地址。: The WeChat service returned an invalid connection URL.
en.微信服务返回了无法解析的响应。: The WeChat service returned an unparseable response.
en.微信服务返回了无法识别的扫码状态。: The WeChat service returned an unrecognized QR-code status.
en.微信服务限流，请稍后重试。: The WeChat service is rate-limiting requests. Try again later.
en.微信消息同步请求被拒绝。: WeChat rejected the message sync request.
en.微信消息连接停止时发生错误。: An error occurred while stopping the WeChat connection.
en.微信激活过程中发生未知错误。: An unknown error occurred while activating the WeChat account.
en.微信登录凭据已失效，请移除账号后重新扫码。: The WeChat login credential has expired. Remove the account and scan a new QR code.
en.微信账号及本机凭据已移除。: The WeChat account and local credentials were removed.
en.微信账号已移除，但工作区设置清理失败。: The WeChat account was removed, but its workspace settings could not be cleaned up.
en.微信账号已移除，但本机状态文件清理失败。: The WeChat account was removed, but its local state file could not be cleaned up.
en.微信账号连接启动失败。: The WeChat account connection could not start.
en.微信账号配置移除失败。: Could not remove the WeChat account configuration.
en.微信连接未就绪。: The WeChat connection is not ready.
en.微信连接检查完成，但测试消息发送失败。: WeChat connection check completed, but the test message could not be sent.
en.微信连接检查完成，测试消息已发送。: WeChat connection check completed and the test message was sent.
en.微信配置格式错误，请检查 config.json 和 workspaces.js: The WeChat configuration is invalid. Check config.json and workspaces.json, then restart DSH.
en.微信配置格式错误：{file}。请查看诊断详情，修复后重启 DSH。: The WeChat configuration is invalid: {file}. See the diagnostic details, fix the file, and restart DSH.
en.微信配置访问权限不足，请检查数据目录权限后重启 DSH。: The WeChat configuration could not be accessed. Check the data directory permissions and restart DSH.
en.必填。只有这些地址发来的邮件会触发 Harness；多个地址用换行或逗号分隔。: Required. Only mail from these addresses triggers the Harness; separate multiple addresses with newlines or commas.
en.思考与工具摘要折叠展示，最终答案在同一张卡片中原地刷新: Thinking and the tool summary stay folded; the final answer refreshes in place inside one card
en.所有发件人同上: Point every sender at the same session
en.所需文件或本地工具不存在，请检查安装和配置。: A required file or local tool is missing. Check installation and configuration.
en.打开企业微信 App，扫描左侧二维码: Open WeCom and scan the QR code
en.打开手机 QQ，扫描左侧二维码: Open mobile QQ and scan the QR code
en.打开手机微信并扫描左侧二维码: Open WeChat on your phone and scan the QR code
en.打开飞书移动端，使用扫一扫读取二维码: Open Feishu on your phone and scan the QR code
en.扫一次码，就能在微信里使用 Harness: Scan once to use Harness in WeChat
en.扫一次码，自动创建并连接机器人: Scan once to create and connect a bot
en.扫码会更新现有飞书应用，只增量开通“获取群组中所有消息”权限；不会创建新应用。确: Scanning updates the existing Feishu app with only the “Read all messages in associated group chat” scope. It does not create a new app. After confirmation, “Respond to all group messages” is enabled automatically; other bots are unaffected.
en.扫码会更新现有飞书应用，增量补充当前缺少的卡片按钮回调、读取用户消息内图片或文件: Scanning updates the existing Feishu app with the missing card-button callback, im:message:readonly for reading images or files in user messages (shown by Feishu as “Read direct and group messages”), im:resource for uploading images or files sent by the bot, im:message.group_at_msg.include_bot:readonly for receiving group messages from other bots that mention this bot, and application:app_slash_command:read / write for the native command panel. It does not create a new app. The confirmation page shows only missing items; this bot reconnects briefly afterward, while other bots are unaffected.
en.扫码只会新增一个机器人，已接入的机器人会继续正常收发消息。: Scanning adds one bot. Existing bots will continue to send and receive messages.
en.扫码接入 QQ 机器人: Connect QQ bot by QR code
en.扫码接入企业微信机器人: Connect WeCom bot by QR code
en.扫码接入微信机器人: Connect WeChat bot by QR code
en.扫码接入钉钉机器人: Connect DingTalk bot by QR code
en.扫码接入飞书机器人: Connect Feishu bot by QR code
en.扫码由腾讯官方页面完成，不需要手动填写 AppID 或 AppSecret。扫码: Scanning is completed on Tencent’s official page. No AppID or AppSecret is required, and the bot connects automatically.
en.扫码由腾讯官方页面完成，不需要手动填写 Bot ID 或 Secret。创建成功: Scanning is completed on Tencent’s official page. No Bot ID or Secret is required, and the bot connects automatically.
en.扫码获得的是私聊身份，群聊只有匹配已确认的所有者身份时才豁免；其他成员按群聊白名: QR setup identifies the owner for direct messages. In groups, only a matching confirmed owner identity is exempt; other members follow the group allowlist settings.
en.扫码账号必须已加入企业/组织。如果钉钉提示尚未加入组织，请在提示页创建组织，或换: The DingTalk account must belong to an organization. If prompted, create an organization or use an account that already belongs to one.
en.扫码，创建第一个飞书入口: Scan to create your first Feishu bot
en.找不到 Harness 健康检查接口。请确认 Harness 与插件版本兼容。: The Harness health check endpoint was not found. Check Harness and plugin compatibility.
en.找不到要修改的机器人。: The bot could not be found.
en.投递目标的标识、结构或路由不符合当前配置版本要求。: The delivery target identifier, structure or route is invalid for this configuration version.
en.拒绝访问不受信任的微信服务地址。: Refusing to access an untrusted WeChat service URL.

en.授权成功；请填写邮箱地址与允许的发件人后完成接入。: Authorized. Enter the mailbox address and at least one allowed sender to finish connecting.
